risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~64% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.099), which favours a robust combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w1' (a seeded deterministic baseline) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.1037. Series context: trend strength 0.7197 and seasonal strength 0.2147; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.099); 6 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.842.
